subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw promote batch selection into the shared message presentation and plugin SDK contract, or explicitly leave richer selection workflows to channel-specific plugins?
rationale: Source confirms a real feature gap, but the permanent public API shape, result encoding, supported-channel matrix, and fallback behavior require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add portable batch selection
options.body: Define an additive array-result presentation block with explicit limits, channel adapters, callback handling, documentation, and a deterministic text fallback.

options.title: Keep channel-specific ownership
options.body: Retain the common single-select contract and document multi-select, modals, and mini-app forms as channel/plugin-specific capabilities.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch selection
recommendation.body: Define an additive array-result presentation block with explicit limits, channel adapters, callback handling, documentation, and a deterministic text fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced and later maintained the shared interactive-rendering seam that this decision would extend.
